Hi Alex — copying Laura (contracts ops) so we can coordinate signature and technical acceptance items. I reviewed Novus_MSA_redline_v3.docx and flagged 4 items that need clarification before we can agree:

1) Data residency / audit access (Section 6): we are OK to provide structured logs, but Novus' requested 90-day on-prem archive is material. Please confirm whether this is firm or if a SOC2-based approach suffices.
2) Indemnity cap & carveouts (Section 12): proposed language broadens operational indemnity; we can accept a capped arrangement but need narrower definition of "Customer Data".
3) PO acceptance window (Order Form): redline asks for 10-day auto-accept — Redwood requires 30 days for manual exceptions unless Ariba auto-accept/reconciliation is configured.
4) Insurance: Novus requests additional insured endorsement — please provide Novus' broker contact or a sample COI form.

Action items I propose:
- 2026-10-05 10:00AM PT: 30m legal sync to walk items 1–3 (Marissa + Alex). If Novus can confirm archive/insurance items as non-blockers we can proceed.
- Karthik/laura to run acceptance windows vs Ariba auto-accept settings on 2026-10-06 call.

We'll prepare a tracked-response (redline + comment sheet) to return by end of day 2026-10-05 after the call.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: Novus_MSA_redline_v3.docx (tracked changes)

Alex + team — thanks for running the sample PO by us on the call this morning. Quick technical summary and open items from our side: 

Summary:
- We can consume Novus' PO XML schema with minor mapping on the line-item accounting block.
- Redwood supports SFTP push from Ariba and can provide a dedicated inbound endpoint (SFTP username) for Novus.
- We can accept 3rd-party invoicing but need one bill-to custodian id in Ariba; that is a configuration on Novus' Ariba tenant.

Open items / asks:
- Please confirm if PO line-level tax_jurisdiction is mandatory on your side. Our default is to read tax codes and map to GL at invoice time, but if Novus requires the field we can include it.
- Provide expected daily volume of POs for sizing (ranges fine).
- Confirm timezone & maintenance windows for the SFTP endpoint (we prefer 0200–0400 PT for inbound syncs).

Attachments: I uploaded a sample mapping (Novus_PO_xml_sample.xml) and our Ariba activation checklist. Laura — can you confirm finance acceptance window and if the 30-day auto-accept is negotiable?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference
